name: Averra Packaging
old_description: As a leading manufacturer of medical packaging solutions, we believe the only barrier standing between your device and optimal patient outcomes should be a sterile one.
about:
Averra Packaging operates from West Valley City, Utah. The company traces its roots to 1989, when it began thermoforming out of a garage. Today it runs a 40,000-square-foot sterile healthcare packaging design and manufacturing facility.

The company designs and manufactures custom medical packaging — including trays, lids, and fulfillment services — as well as consumer packaging. Its process covers design and development, in-house prototyping that delivers true thermoformed samples in days, a Bridge Tooling™ step for production-equivalent parts, in-house tooling via its own machine shop, and full-scale production. The facility is ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certified, operates a Class 8 cleanroom, and uses redundant equipment to handle volumes from hundreds to tens of millions of parts.

Averra serves the medical device and consumer goods industries. Its medical customers include companies developing life-altering devices that require sterile barrier systems, while its consumer division focuses on high-quality retail packaging. The firm also acts as a manufacturer of record, combining packaging expertise with regulatory documentation under one roof.

The company says it was driven by a purpose to deliver smart, effective packaging that meets modern business demands, emphasizing that the only barrier between a device and patient outcomes should be a sterile one. It highlights sustainable practices: 75 percent of materials contain recycled content, one million pounds of post-production waste are recycled annually, and 96 percent of its products are recyclable.
